descriptor.retrieval_description: Metallic combination padlock with a smooth, dry, curved metallic housing body. The intended contact region is clean with continuous curvature across the lateral faces.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing sides of the lock body housing
descriptor.local_geometry: Smooth, rounded cylindrical curvature with a flat face and a dial interruption on the front
descriptor.uncertainty: The rear surface of the lock body is not visible, but the lateral sides are clearly presented.
